# svg-slides set: Dark Academia (`academia`)

<!-- GENERATED by bin/draw-slide-sets.js. Edit the script, then re-run it. -->

Dark Academia: warm near-black brown with antique-gold titles in italic Georgia, parchment-coloured body text, a double inset border frame (a heavy outer and a hairline inner rule), centred wide-tracked titles, thin gold rules and Courier New footnote captions. The light theme is the print inverse: parchment paper, deep-brown text, the same gold accents. Not any template's brand.

```
node bin/compose-slide.js title-hero --set academia --payload payload.json --theme light --out slides/
```

The six slide designs keep the lab set's slot names, kinds, required flags and line counts, so any
payload that fits these budgets composes in every set. Character budgets follow this set's fonts.
Shared conventions, gates and the layout rule: [`../../README.md`](../../README.md).

**References** (composition and palette cues only, no assets copied):
- Dark Academia aesthetic palettes (colour-palette write-ups): near-black warm brown, antique gold, parchment, muted gold, dark-gold borders.
- Library and manuscript page conventions: double ruled frames, centred title pages, footnotes set in a monospace or small caps.

## Catalog

| # | Design | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `title-hero` | Cover: warm dark field in a double inset gold frame (heavy outer, hairline inner, corner studs); a diamond rule above the centred eyebrow and below the meta line; the title is italic gold Georgia with wide tracking. |
| 2 | `section-break` | Section divider: double gold frame; the chapter number, centred and oversized in italic gold, over a short diamond rule, then the eyebrow, a two-line italic title and the orientation line. |
| 3 | `big-statement` | Takeaway slide: double gold frame; a centred three-line italic statement between two short diamond rules, with the mono eyebrow above and the attribution below. |
| 4 | `content-two-col` | Content slide: gold frame; heading over a hairline rule; body text with a gold-barred key point on the left; the graphic sits in a double-ruled plate with a Courier footnote caption. |
| 5 | `full-diagram` | Figure slide: gold frame; a large double-ruled plate for the graphic and a narrower double-ruled plate for the takeaway on the right. |
| 6 | `closing` | Closing slide: the cover's double frame and diamond rules; a centred italic gold title, up to three centred contact lines and a mono meta line. |
